narr: A mid-level trough across the Great Lakes helped push a weak cold front into the central North Carolina Piedmont during the evening and overnight hours. Ahead of the front, storms over the Ohio Valley and West Virginia produced additional surface boundaries across the northern Piedmont. The approach of the front led to development of scattered to numerous showers and storms across the northwest Piedmont in the late-evening hours, tapering off around midnight. The strongest storms produced downed trees and flash flooding in Forsyth County.
ev: A stretch of University Parkway near Northwest Blvd was temporally closed due to flooding.
